divergence_justification: Human override of the attempt_0004 block; full argument in mimic-iv/concepts_fhir/human_override/antibiotic.md (re-applied 2026-08-25). attempt_0004 is a [replay:data_rebuild] of attempt_0003 carried forward byte-identical (concept.sql sha 23533b07..., see replay_provenance.json), so the served data is the only changed variable. The rebuild's DST fix (mimic-fhir ade10fb, upstream #124) reached this path and closed that divergence completely: differing_conflict 70 -> 0, conflict_attribution null, columns_conflicting {}, tier contested -> gap_shaped. The reopen's tripwire -- treat any surviving hour-wide shift as a finding -- is therefore not triggered. The remaining residual is unchanged to the row from the twice-accepted gap: MIMIC-on-FHIR omits MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.validityPeriod entirely (both endpoints) whenever mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_request.sql:172-177 fails its 'ph_STARTTIME IS NOT NULL AND ph_STARTTIME <= ph_STOPTIME' guard, and no other served element carries prescriptions.starttime/stoptime: authoredOn at :55,124 is pharmacy entertime, fhir_medication_dispense.sql carries no prescription times, fhir_medication_administration.sql:177 carries emar charttime at another grain, and identifiers carry identity only (resource-id inversion refused per LOOP_CONTRACT.md:317-333). This explains all 43,453 differing_null_only rows (starttime NULL 43,369; stoptime NULL 43,422; stay_id NULL 13,494 via the temporal ICU LEFT JOIN at mimic-iv/concepts/medication/antibiotic.sql:198-201), decomposing into 43,338 reversed intervals that FHIR R4 Period invariant per-1 makes intrinsically unrepresentable and 115 one-sided-NULL rows lost to a NULL-unsafe guard, a small fixable upstream defect. Not essential loss per LOOP_CONTRACT.md:481: row counts are equal at 735,462 with delta 0, the residual paired 1:1 on (subject_id, hadm_id, antibiotic, route) with matching multiplicity and zero only_oracle/only_candidate, the concept has no GROUP BY, window or carry-forward, the icustays join is a LEFT JOIN on both sides (canonical :198-201, port concept.sql:265-268) so a NULL starttime drops the ICU match without dropping the row, and every gap is emitted as typed NULL rather than an estimate. Fidelity 692,009/735,462 identical (94.0917%), up 70 rows from attempt_0003. Consistency: siblings acei, arb and nsaid were replayed against the same 2026-08-24 warehouse in the same wave and all three were accepted by the judge on this identical ETL gap, acei at 8.09% and arb at 8.04% affected -- larger fractions than antibiotic's 5.91% -- so blocking this concept splits identical concepts contrary to LOOP_CONTRACT.md:512-516. The judge's attempt_0004 finding is verbatim its attempt_0003 finding, which per LOOP_CONTRACT.md:850-856 it cannot be asked to reconsider, so it carries no new evidence. Downstream suspicion_of_infection/sepsis3 inherit and cite this acceptance per LOOP_CONTRACT.md:929-950; suspicion_of_infection still holds a pre-rebuild verdict and needs its own replay.

reopen_history.reason: Type B cast defect: TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(REGEXP_REPLACE(col, offset-strip), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss[.SSSSSS]") returns NULL on any shape the pinned format misses (date-only values especially), and TRY_ makes it silent -- those NULLs reach the judge as differing_null_only/gap_shaped, i.e. a parse failure disguised as a FHIR coverage gap at the lower bar. Replace every datetime mapping with a bare TRY_CAST(col AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ). See pathling-sql SKILL.md and MIMIC_NOTES.md:337.
reopen_history.superseded_justification: Judge accepted attempt 0001's contested unkeyed multiset divergence. The missing FHIR paths are MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.validityPeriod.start/end: mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_request.sql:172-177 omits invalid or incomplete intervals, and authoredOn at :55,124 is pharmacy entertime rather than either source endpoint, so ICU stay_id cannot be reconstructed when starttime is absent. The same ETL at :43-44 irreversibly normalizes DST-gap endpoints through TIMESTAMPTZ (+3600 seconds). Exhaustive EXCEPT ALL pairing accounted for all 43,576 mirrored divergences, with no invented rows; all defensible direct/mix mappings and filters were applied. The judge reported 691,886/735,462 exact tuples (94.075%).

reopen_history.reason: Downstream SQL-on-FHIR consumers join derived tables on getResourceKey() resource keys, which the port computes internally but drops at the outermost SELECT. The attempt adds the paired key column beside each MIMIC identifier column (subject_id->patient_key, hadm_id->encounter_key, stay_id->icu_encounter_key, specimen_id->specimen_key). Additive and shape-only: both comparison paths project manifest columns explicitly, so no compared value can change. The MIMIC integer columns are retained as the oracle join keys.
reopen_history.superseded_justification: Accepted by equivalence judge: MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.validityPeriod.start/end are intrinsically omitted for reversed or incomplete intervals by mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_request.sql:172-177, while authoredOn and identifiers at :55,75,111-124 preserve neither original endpoints nor the ICU assignment input; this explains all 43,453 differing_null_only rows and stay_id gaps. The same ETL casts endpoints through TIMESTAMPTZ at :43-44, irreversibly normalizing America/New_York DST-gap wall times; request-level re-pairing accounts for all 70 conflicts, including the three comparator positional-pairing artifacts at src/mimic_utils/compare_port_results.py:1342-1355. All defensible mappings were applied and no query can recover the lost values.

reopen_history.reason: [replay:data_rebuild] The MIMIC-on-FHIR warehouse was rebuilt on 2026-08-24 after two upstream data defects were fixed: FHIR resources are now generated under UTC, so wall-clock timestamps are no longer shifted an hour across the spring-forward boundary, and Patient.birthDate is now derived from the anchor year and age rather than from the first transfer. This port was carried forward byte-identical to re-measure it against the corrected data -- do not re-author it. Expect previously accepted divergences to have shrunk or gone; if an hour-wide shift still appears, treat it as a finding and establish why the correction did not reach that path rather than accepting it as an upstream artifact.
